translation: will grant me a manifestation, and whatever is revealed to me I will tell you.” And he

translation: up the seven altars and offered up a bull and a ram on each altar.”

translation: And יהוה put a word in Balaam’s mouth and said, “Return to Balak

translation: and speak thus.” So he returned to him and found him standing beside his offerings, and all

the Moabite dignitaries with him. He took up his theme, and said:

translation:
Balak brought me,
Moab’s king from the hills of the East:
